name: How do I choose the right contractor for home accessibility work?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for home accessibility work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for a general contractor who brings hands-on framing, tile, and finish experience, rather than an administrative broker who simply subcontracts every task. Accessibility work demands meticulous precision: blocking must hold heavy loads, tile slopes must drain without pooling, and transitions must be completely smooth. Working directly with an owner-operator like Abraham Becerra provides a single point of contact on-site, ensuring safety-critical framing, backing, and finish details are built correctly from start to finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an experienced contractor who handles framing, drywall, and tile directly to guarantee solid wall backing, proper floor slopes, and direct accountability on-site.
